markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
The conformal set, MUSK model and all 5 similar cases agree on Normal [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 93%, InSitu 6% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 86th percentile | Usable despite simulated blur |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Scored above typical; linked to non-invasive tissue [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 2, 8) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored very low, giving a small invasive lean [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Mildly above typical; near-zero contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; this case leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) hides in-situ features; InSitu already holds 6%.
- Test set is small: calibration error 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18); reliability score ranks errors only modestly.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 9:** listed for duct-confined and infiltrating-stroma concepts; confirm ducts and stroma are benign.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 8:** confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 10:** strongest pleomorphism score; check whether the nuclei are truly atypical.
